SELECT
    achado_id,
    tipo_risco,
    nivel_risco,
    filial,
    usuario,
    valor,
    data_execucao
FROM auditoria.log_auditoria
WHERE data_execucao >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND status_tratamento = 'ABERTO'
ORDER BY achado_id, valor DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    achado_id,
    nivel_risco,
    status_tratamento,
    COUNT(*) AS total_registros,
    SUM(valor) AS valor_total
FROM auditoria.log_auditoria
WHERE status_tratamento != 'ENCERRADO'
GROUP BY achado_id, nivel_risco, status_tratamento
ORDER BY achado_id;

SELECT
    achado_id,
    tipo_risco,
    nivel_risco,
    responsavel_acao,
    data_limite_acao,
    status_tratamento,
    valor
FROM auditoria.log_auditoria
WHERE data_limite_acao BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
  AND status_tratamento != 'ENCERRADO'
ORDER BY data_limite_acao ASC;

SELECT 
    SUM(valor_max) AS valor_unico
FROM (
    SELECT 
        nr_documento,
        MAX(valor) AS valor_max
    FROM auditoria.log_auditoria
    WHERE status_tratamento != 'ENCERRADO'
    GROUP BY nr_documento
) AS dedup;
